meta.name: deploy-checklist
meta.description: Execute a structured deployment to staging or production. Use when asked to deploy, ship, release, push to production, or promote to staging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按清单执行结构化部署到预发或生产环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要可靠地部署代码到预发或生产环境
copy.tagline_en: Execute a structured deployment to staging or production
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reliably deploy code to staging or production

howto.what: 执行结构化的部署流程，先确认目标环境和部署内容，检查代码、运行测试，然后执行部署命令，最后进行健康检查和短期监控。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布或推送时触发，需要先明确目标是 staging 还是 production。

say.text: 发布当前分支到production，先跑测试
say.note: 确保测试通过后再发布
先展示待部署的提交记录

howto.what_en: Executes a structured deployment to staging or production: confirms target env, checks branch and uncommitted changes, runs tests, shows changelog, runs deploy command, waits for success, then health check and 2-min monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to deploy, ship, release, push to production, or promote to staging; requires explicit target (staging or production).

say_en.text: Release current branch to production, run tests first

say_en.note: Shows commits to be deployed first
